title: Resolve the shallow IDnaSerializer abstraction (simplify or make the seam real)
description:
## Summary

Resolve the shallow `IDnaSerializer` abstraction: one sealed implementation, statically constructed by every caller, with the interface providing no meaningful substitution or policy boundary. An external audit (P2, inherited from an earlier finding) recommends either removing the interface in favor of the concrete serializer, or making the seam real at one composition root.

Provenance: `docs/audits/creaturecreator-deep-dive-code-review-audit-26-09-05-23-07-45.md` F5 (P2). Verified at current HEAD `99fe6ad`: `Assets/Scripts/Runtime/Serialization/IDnaSerializer.cs` has one concrete `JsonDnaSerializer`; callers (`CreatureEditorSession`, `CreatureEditorWindow`, `CreatureRuntimePreview`) statically `new JsonDnaSerializer()` and store it in an `IDnaSerializer` field.

## Scope

`Assets/Scripts/Runtime/Serialization/IDnaSerializer.cs`, `JsonDnaSerializer.cs`, and callers:

- Choose one honest contract: (a) remove the interface and use the concrete `JsonDnaSerializer` directly, or (b) if serialization policy is truly intended to vary, move construction to a single composition root and inject it into callers.
- Do not create an interface factory solely to justify the existing interface.
- Preserve current serialization behavior, canonicalize-then-serialize semantics, and all `JsonDnaSerializer*` test coverage.
- Do not change the `CreatureEditorWindow`/session behavior beyond the construction-site change.

## Acceptance Criteria

- The repository has either no `IDnaSerializer` abstraction or exactly one composition/injection boundary for serializer construction.
- Callers no longer statically bind to the concrete type through a nominally abstract field unless a second serializer policy is actually planned.
- Serialization tests remain green and disk/session round-trips are unchanged.

## Validation

Focused runtime/editor serialization round-trip tests after the change, plus the full Unity suites. Static source inspection alone cannot close this task.

## Findings

- `CreatureEditorWindow -> IDnaSerializer field -> new JsonDnaSerializer()` is not materially more replaceable than `CreatureEditorWindow -> JsonDnaSerializer`.
- Docs describe parser swapping as isolated behind `IDnaSerializer`, but concrete construction sites mean a swap still requires caller edits unless a composition mechanism is added.

## Blockers

None known.

## Next Step

Decide simplify-vs-inject and apply the change with serialization round-trip tests.
